Changing hero clears the figure and failed-image fallback

Repeated submission after handoff cannot spend another charge or announce another success
Opponent can make a normal board move after a successful pull and equipment handoff
Black-side UI mirror commits the same one-square displacement and two-use resource

limits: Actual built web/app.js and its module graph execute against a simulated DOM; fixtures are appended in memory only.
No browser layout, CSS pixel rendering, native touch, image decoding, physical device, Bluetooth or online acceptance.
Chromium was blocked by socket EPERM; the separate cloud browser could not reach the local server.
Prepared positions are interface checks, not human playtesting or a balance proof.
